name: Agnes
source:
Bright and uninhibited in terms of sex.
Is domineering but has the character of a good girl.

While it was nice to beat the Demon King and bring peace upon the world, for "Agnes" who became NEET, she had too much time to spare.

Therefore, with her own authority she entered the orc school in the rural area.
The purpose was "playing" with the strong and energetic guys there.

While she had slender arms, she was more powerful than orcs and pushed them down, squeezing everything out of them.
Since she had the most power and authority within the school, she did as she much she wanted.
